q: By the end of March 2027, a phased U.S.-Iran agreement (one that puts reopening the strait and lifting the blockade first and defers the nuclear issue to a later stage) is signed, and for at least 90 days after signing the strait stays open and the blockade stays lifted
basis: Precedent: the U.S.-Iran memorandum of understanding of June 17, 2026, effectively collapsed three weeks later, on July 8 · Checked against prior attempts, Iran issue
rs: The text of the agreement, plus statements by the U.S. and Iranian governments and Reuters/AP reporting over the 90 days after signing
